meta.title: Advisor
meta.description: Configure the advisor reviewer model that observes the primary transcript and injects severity-ranked advice.

en.defaultEnabledHint: New sessions start with the advisor on; turn it off to make the advisor opt-in per session (enable with /advisor on).
en.namespaceUnavailable: The advisor configuration channel is not available yet — the settings gateway is not ready on this host. Configure the advisor via the plugin config row — `- id: advisor` whose `config:` map sets `provider`/`model` (e.g. `config: { provider: …, model: … }`) in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`. The advisor plugin runs fully from its plugin config row; the web settings form becomes available again on the next load once the gateway is reachable. Note: `/advisor` only toggles the advisor per session; it cannot supply provider/model.
en.nextPromptHint: Show the reviewer’s suggested next prompt as a tip below the composer; press → to insert it.
en.noModels: This provider has no available models. Configure models for it on the Models page.
en.noProviders: No configured providers. Configure one on the Models page first.
en.proseFallbackHint: When no JSON frame is found, deliver the prose reply as a low-severity note — for models that answer in prose instead of JSON.
en.readOnly: Settings are read-only in this environment.
en.reasoningEffortHint: Leave empty to use the smallest thinking effort the selected model declares.
en.reasoningEffortStale: The stored thinking effort is not declared by the selected model. Reselect one or keep the stored value.
en.reasoningEffortUnavailable: Thinking-effort options are currently unavailable for the selected model — only automatic is available.
en.saved: Advisor settings saved. New sessions pick them up immediately.
en.sessionAdvisorOff: The advisor is off for this session.
en.sessionCollapse: Close the advisor controls for this session
en.sessionExpand: Open the advisor controls for this session
en.sessionLifetime: Lives for this session only — never persisted; cleared on dispose or restart. A new or forked session inherits the global defaults.
en.sessionNoPair: No reviewer model — the global default has no provider/model.
en.sessionUnavailable: The advisor session control surface is not available on this host. Use /advisor model in the session, or configure the global defaults on the Plugins page.
en.staleModel: The stored model is no longer available for this provider. Reselect one or keep the stored value.
en.staleProvider: The stored provider is no longer configured. Reselect one or keep the stored value.
en.systemPromptHint: Leave empty to use the default system prompt
